content: Haa 'aitsie kemɨrane
Yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi makumawetsie Tsini mekaniu'axɨani mexɨakame metseriyaritsie, Karetsi rakutewakaku mekanitiyaxe. Mana Miriyami mamɨtsie meta mana kaniukateukieni.
Mana haa waɨkawa mumawekaikɨ, 'ixaheritsixi mekaniutiniukixietɨkɨne Muitsexi hepaɨtsita meta 'Aruni,
Muitsexi mɨpaɨ mekateniutatieni: «Yawé kuta ta'iwama wahamatɨa temekwinikɨ mɨtanepitɨakaitɨni.
¿Tamɨ tame Yawé tekateteɨterimama? ¿Titayari 'ena makumawetsie petareyewitɨ temɨkwinikɨ tatewama wahamatɨa?
¿Titayari 'Ekipitu petarayewitɨ 'ena 'axa'anekɨa petati'atɨa? 'Ena kaniumaweni 'imɨari, piní, kaxie, 'ikwaxi mayehatsiyatɨka, matsi 'akuxi haa tiumawe».
Muitsexi meta 'Aruni mewaruhayewaka mekanekɨne 'ixuriki tukiyari hɨxie, mana mekaniutihɨxima'uni. Hikɨ Yawé xawatɨriyaya kaniyuhekɨata wahɨxie,
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:

«'A'itsɨ keneutikwe'i teɨteri keniwarukuxeɨrieka. Mɨkɨ wahɨxie 'ekɨ meta 'Aruni, 'ai mɨpaɨ xekatenitahɨawikuni haa kehanetɨani. Mɨpaɨ xeteyurieyu haa kananemɨkɨ teɨteri meta tewaxi xekaniwatiharitɨakuni».
Yawé kemainekai mɨpaɨ Muitsexi katiniuyurieni, 'itsɨ kaniutikweni Yawé hɨxie mutiwekai.
Hikɨ Muitsexi, 'Aruni hamatɨa teɨteri mekaniwarukuxeɨrieni 'ai hɨxie, Muitsexi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Xekeneu'enana, 'axaxemɨte'u'iyari. ¿Kamɨtsɨ teteyɨwawe 'ikɨ 'aitsie haa temanetɨani?»
Mɨpaɨ 'utayɨka yu'itsɨkɨ 'ai hutakɨa kaniuwani, hikɨ haa kananeni waɨkawa, mana teɨteri meta watewama mekaniutihareni.

Yawé, Muitsexi 'Aruni mame mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Nehetsie yuri xemɨkate'eriekɨ, kenemɨtipatsie xemɨka'imatekɨ 'ixaheritsixi wahɨxie, xeme xepɨkahɨkɨtɨni xemɨwaranuwitɨni hakewa kwie nemɨxehexatɨa».
Mɨkɨ haa mɨpaɨ katinimatiwani, haa manakaxɨrɨwe Meriwa, mana 'ixaheritsixi Yawé memutatikɨ, mana kemɨtipatsie muyuhekɨataxɨkɨ.
'Erumi 'Ixaheri huyeyari mutikweri
Karetsi 'ukaitɨ Muitsexi kaniwarenɨ'ani texaxatamete ti'aitame 'Erumi kiekame hetsɨa, mɨpaɨ tiwarahɨawetɨ: «Mɨpaɨ 'a'iwa 'Ixaheri kanaineni: “'Ekɨ pepɨtimate kehepaɨ temɨte'uka'eniwa.
Pepɨrakumate tatutsima 'Ekipitu memekɨ, hakewa mɨixa wiyari teme'uwakai, metatsiere pepɨtimate 'Ekipitu kiekatari kememɨtate'u'uximatɨakai tame meta tapaapama.
Metatsiere pepɨtimate Yawé ketemɨte'utawawiri tatsi'u'enieka, yuniuki tuayame kataneyenɨ'airieni 'Ekipitu mɨtatsi'ayewitɨ. »”'Enari tekaniuhuni Karetsi, hakewa 'akwie meka'atɨka.

Mɨpaɨ tematewawirie pemɨtatsipitɨanikɨ 'akwietsie temuyekɨnekɨ. Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nepaine nixeime 'a'etsaripa mana tepɨkaheuyekɨne meta xeime putsuta tepɨkahetihareni. Huyeta xeikɨa tepɨyehu 'amatayewa 'utɨma, hawaikɨ tekaheukuyuyuipiketɨ kepaukake temanuyekɨne”».

Hikɨ ti'aitame 'Erumi kiekame mɨpaɨ katineinɨ'airieni: «Hakewa nemɨre'aita 'etsiwatɨma mana xepɨka'uyekɨkani, xɨka mɨpaɨ xeheyɨni, ne nekanayeyeimɨkɨ nekuyaxima newarawitɨtɨ muwa tekanixehetaxeiyakuni».

'Ixaheritsixi tawarita mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: «Huye 'amatayewa 'utɨma xeikɨa tepɨyehu, xɨka tatewama yatɨni tame hawaikɨ 'aputsuta tehetihareni tepɨte'ayukatuani. Tame tematsiwawirie xeikɨa mana temuyekɨnekɨ».
'Erumi kwieyaritsie ti'aitame haxɨama mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «'Ena xeme xepɨka'uyekɨne». Hikɨ kanayeyani kuyaxi waɨkawa memɨyɨwawe warawɨtɨtɨ,
kawapitɨanike kwieyatsie memuyekɨnekɨ. Hikɨ 'ixaheritsixi xaɨtsie pɨta mekaneukanɨ'arieni yamekateha'eriwatɨ.
'Aruni kaniumɨni
Hikɨ yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi Karetsi mekanayekɨne Huxi hɨriyaritsie mekaniu'axɨani,
'Erumi kwieya mata'atɨkatsie. Mana Yawé Muitsexi meta 'Aruni mame mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe:
«'Aruni 'apɨka'uyeikani 'ena kwiepa 'ari kanimɨmɨkɨ, kwie hakewa 'ixaheritsixi nemɨwarexatɨa mana pɨkaheutahani, xeme xeyuhutatɨ xemɨkanetsi'anu'enikɨ kenemɨxerahɨawekai haa Meriwa maneikakaitsie.
Hikɨ 'Aruni meta nu'aya 'Eriyatsaxi keniwaranuwitɨki Huxi hɨriyaritsie.
Mana 'Aruni pekanetikemaripiemɨkɨ mawari wewiwame kamixateya mɨranakatɨkɨ, nu'aya 'Eriyatsaxi pekatinanakatɨtɨamɨkɨ, manari 'Aruni kanimɨmɨkɨ».
Muitsexi yakatiniuyurieni Yawé kemɨrehɨawekai. Yunaime teɨteri wahɨxie, yuhaikatɨ Huxi hɨriyaritsie mekanitiyune.
Hikɨ Muitsexi, 'Aruni mawari wewiwame kamixateyari kanenutihɨnirieni, 'Eriyatsaxi pɨta kananakatɨtɨani. Mana hɨritsie 'Aruni kaniɨmɨni. Hikɨ Muitsexi 'Eriyatsaxi hamatɨa hɨritsie mekananakakɨne.
Kepauka yunaitɨ memɨtehetima kename 'Aruni hemɨkai, xeitewiyari heimana tamamata tukari mekanitsuariwiyatɨwekaitɨni.
